lines.rookie:
There are 28 letters.
Five main consonant letters copy the shapes we make to speak.
They show the tongue, the mouth, the teeth and the throat.
The dot is the round sky. The flat line is the flat earth. The standing line is a person.
The King made them so people can learn them easily and use them every day.
The book says a slow person can learn them in ten days.
Now find the line on the page that does not match.
lines.junior:
There are 28 letters in all.
Five main consonant letters copy the shapes we make when we speak.
They show the tongue, the mouth, the teeth and the throat.
The dot stands for the round sky, the flat line for the flat earth, and the standing line for a person.
The King made them so that people can learn them easily and use them every day.
The book says that even a slow person can learn them in ten days.
Now find the line on the page that does not match.
lines.master:
The new script has 28 letters.
Five main consonant letters are modelled on the shapes we form as we speak.
They picture the tongue, the mouth, the teeth and the throat.
The dot represents the round sky, the flat line the flat earth, and the standing line a person.
The King created them so that people could learn them with ease and use them each day.
The book claims that even a slow learner can learn them in ten days.
Now find the one line on the page that does not match.
